Instrument (EN): Positive Mental Health Scale — original nine-item development and validation
Scales / measured domains (EN): Unidimensional positive mental health: positive emotional/psychological/social well-being, self-efficacy and life satisfaction-related wellness; one total construct, not 3 independently validated subscales.
Research provenance: Lukat J, Margraf J, Lutz R, van der Veld WM, Becker ES. BMC Psychology 2016-02-10;4:8 DOI 10.1186/s40359-016-0111-x. Multi-study student n5406, patient n1547, general n3204 (total 10157 across participating samples); unidimensional; partial metric and partial scalar invariance across samples, with scalar invariance across time; test-retest and sensitivity to treatment change examined. Original instrument developed from German item pools.
DB locales: None published under PMH in 149-key/234-version Holistic House assessment_versions snapshot on 2026-10-26.

Other translations: German-origin original respondent measure used in German sample context; DE original is not a new translated German adaptation. Confirm source German item copy and author licence before administration.
Target population: German university students n5406, psychiatric patients n1547 and general population n3204 across multi-study analyses; not a single nationally representative population.
Commercial digital use / permission revi: RESEARCH_ONLY / PERMISSION_REQUIRED. Verification notes / safety gate: Do not confuse PMH nine-item unidimensional scale with Positive Mental Health Questionnaire Short Form PMHQ-SF18 (already catalogued). PMH scores do not diagnose absence of depression. English paper language != English respondent validation.
